title: Unit 36 Consolidation: The Hungarian Tradition of Liberty
goal: I can use the words for passive resistance, rights, freedom without fear, the Compromise and civic responsibility.
I can say what was not done, name a right, ask a rhetorical question, contrast two views and link two duties.
I can write one sentence about civic responsibility with *nemcsak … hanem*.
